mapping.all_index_slots: Emit one ordered TEI ab for every source BZV slot; preserve its numeric source identity and map its SWORD KJV key position without asserting print-volume boundaries.
mapping.valid_utf8: Preserve text order and map only source-evidenced ThML: i to hi rend=italic, br to lb, scripRef to ref type=scripture with passage retained literally in n and version retained literally in subtype, and blockquote to quote type=block. Derive each Bible position only from the retained module configuration, SWORD KJV key order, and the bound KJV canon table; never infer it from carrier text or generated Bible JSON. Keep unknown tags and unsupported attributes visible as escaped source markup and list them in source-accountability.json.
mapping.invalid_utf8_and_xml_controls: Emit a TEI gap and retain exact original bytes as hex and SHA-256 in source-accountability.json; do not replacement-decode or discard controls.
mapping.archive_and_index_material: Bind archive, index, compressed data, block index, module config, block lengths, and every carrier range by digest/accounting.

bible_positions.versification_rule: Use the retained Barnes module's Versification value; when absent, CrossWire SWORD zCom uses its KJV default.
bible_positions.position_order: Module heading; New Testament heading; then, for each KJV New Testament book in canon order, its book heading followed by each chapter heading and every verse in order.
bible_positions.tei_attributes: Keep @n as the zero-based source slot; encode each stable position in TEI @subtype as kind:key. Keys are module-heading, testament.2, the OSIS book code, OSIS-book.chapter, and OSIS-book.chapter.verse for module, testament, book, chapter, and verse positions respectively.
bible_positions.position_stream: SHA-256 over UTF-8 lines '<zero-based slot> TAB <kind> TAB <key>', joined with LF and no trailing LF.

unresolved: 60 invalid-UTF-8 carriers and 76 further XML-incompatible carriers cannot be emitted as readable TEI characters from this retained binary module without a source-local resolution.
Four blockquote starts in three valid carriers have no close within their BZV slot; TEI closes each quote at that slot boundary and source-accountability.json records the open source structure.
Print edition, original textual form, and volume boundaries are not adopted from the module label.
Human acceptance, rights clearance, release, and publication remain separate decisions.
